fact: Raxio's own specification page says the MZ1 data centre in Matola takes a 15 kV utility supply fed directly from the nearest substation with N+N redundancy, with 2N power distribution from MV transformer to rack PDU and 48 hours of on-site fuel; the page has no date, so the capture date 2026-08-08 is used.
Raxio's own specification page states a PUE of 1.3 for the MZ1 data centre, with indirect adiabatic cooling; the page has no date, so the capture date 2026-08-08 is used.

Raxio CTO Rob Saunders says Raxio invests in medium-voltage lines direct from the substation to its facility in each market and always uses two independently sufficient power lines, plus diesel generators.
